notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 148 from 5 August 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3S0TObWihybmZdCLM6wIUw?si=cf08fccbb9d44fa7) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with a Stasis build. Jurisprudent is a decent enough stasis scout rifle, for when you want to stay a long way away from trouble. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are fine - d2foundry.gg calculates that 68 Range equates to 40.91m hipfire and 81.82m when ADS before damage falloff, 23 Stability is ×1.0750 flinch resist at base, 28 Handling is 0.46s ready, 0.36s ADS and 0.44s stow speed, and 33 Reload Speed is a 2.32s reload. Ammo Regeneration is 55, Recoil Direction is 66, and Zoom is 21. With the slower fire rate of a high-impact scout rifle, stability isn't too much of an issue, so focus on Handling to improve snappiness with the barrel perk. For the magazine perk, Tactical Mag, Flared Magwell or Alloy Mag are reliable options for boosting gunfeel stats. For Stasis builds, you have the Rimestealer and Headstone combination to build Frost Armor stacks on killing frozen enemies or shattering Stasis crystals, which you can generate on crit kills. The Bray Legacy Origin Trait is solid in PvE, generating around 0.2% energy per hit for whichever ability is closest to a full charge. If you're interested, the word "Jurisprudent" means an expert in, or relating to the theory and philosophy of the law. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
